answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, which means holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in orchard and zenith lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the river graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1593 impostors cost 704 times the honest price and take 22 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
